user_story: As a user, I want to add a new record to the web table, so that I can keep track of my data easily. Acceptance criteria: The user can click on the button with id 'addNewRecordButton' to open the form, fill in the fields, and submit to see the new record in the table. If the user tries to submit the form with empty fields, the URL should not change, and the table should remain visible.
cypress_script:
cy.visit('https://demoqa.com/webtables')
  .get('#addNewRecordButton').click()
  .get('input[id="firstName"]').type('John')
  .get('input[id="lastName"]').type('Doe')
  .get('input[id="userEmail"]').type('john.doe@example.com')
  .get('input[id="age"]').type('30')
  .get('input[id="salary"]').type('50000')
  .get('input[id="department"]').type('Engineering')
  .get('button.btn.btn-primary').contains('Submit').click()
  .url().should('include', '/webtables')
  .get('table').contains('John Doe')

  it('should not submit the form with empty fields and stay on the same page', () => {
    cy.get('#addNewRecordButton').click()
    cy.get('button.btn.btn-primary').contains('Submit').click()
    cy.url().should('include', '/webtables')
    cy.get('table').should('be.visible')
  });
